sequence.description: Protein sequence (uppercase 1-letter codes) to analyze. Mutually exclusive with `fasta_path`.

fasta_path.description: FASTA file path containing one or more sequences to analyze. Multi-sequence inputs are treated as a family/MSA-style batch.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's `sequence` into the `sequence` input when omitted.

positions.description: 1-indexed residue positions to annotate explicitly. Empty list annotates everything up to `max_annotations`.

ph.description: pH at which charged-residue and isoelectric calculations are performed. Default 7.4 (physiological).

max_annotations.description: Cap on per-residue annotations emitted. 0 disables per-residue annotation entirely; raise for full sequences.

include_regions.description: When true, include detected liability regions (deamidation, oxidation, isomerization, polybasic) in the output.

include_residue_table.description: When true, write the per-residue annotation TSV artifact for downstream tools.

output_prefix.description: Filename prefix for the generated artifacts (TSV/JSON). Filesystem-safe characters only.
